themes.name: AI power and the grid
themes.what: Oracle sent a force majeure notice on Project Jupiter, a site designed for up to 2.45 GW of Bloom fuel cells, after its gas pipeline slipped to Feb 1, 2027; Oracle says the project is on schedule. Separately, Blue Energy filed to connect a Texas gas plus nuclear plant to ERCOT, starting with about 1 GW of GE Vernova turbines. On site power still depends on gas hookups, and turbine orders keep landing at GE Vernova.

themes.name: Critical materials and geopolitics
themes.what: Freeport's Grasberg mill ran at about 67% of normal in Q3 2026, short of the earlier 85% goal, and the new target is 80% by mid 2027. Copper supply stays tighter for longer, with COMEX copper about $6.66/lb on Oct 9.

themes.name: Defense, drones and reshoring
themes.what: Raytheon won a multiyear SM-3 Block IB interceptor contract worth up to $6.3 billion, about $4.4 billion of it in the base years, with work through 2034. Missile defense money keeps moving into multiyear deals, which gives RTX and its suppliers years of visibility.

themes.name: Healthcare and Medtech: Aging, Heart, Sugar, Hearing, Sight
themes.what: iRhythm closed its VitalConnect purchase on Oct 5, ahead of the year end target, for $237.5 million cash plus up to 423,334 shares. It adds mobile cardiac telemetry and hospital monitoring to Zio, widening the heart rhythm funnel it already feeds.

themes.name: Space, Quantum and Cyber: Government Funded Frontier Tech
themes.what: The FCC approved SpaceX's plan for 15,000 direct to phone satellites (order dated Oct 6), though use of the EchoStar bands waits on a close expected by Nov 30, 2027. DARPA moved IonQ and IBM into the final stage of its quantum benchmarking program on Oct 7; IonQ's deal is worth up to $300 million through 2029.
